text.en:
The following sums, or so much thereof as may be necessary, are appropriated for the
Department of Agriculture and Commerce, out of the collections that accrued and shall accrue to the Coconut
Oil Excise Tax Fund in the Philippine Treasury on and after January first, nineteen hundred and thirty-nine,
for the purposes hereunder specified, for the fiscal year ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and forty-six:
(a) Apprpriation to continue the agronomical survey of the Philippines in accordance with the provisions of
Commonwealth Act No. 418. . . . . . . . . . . . . P168,000.00
(b) Appropriation for the establishment, improvement, development, maintenance, and operation of
agricultural experiment and demonstration stations under the provisions of section 1754 of the Administrative
(c) Appropriation to continue the reforestation and afforestation of watersheds, denuded areas, and cogon or
open lands within forest reserves, communal forests, National parks, and timberlands, sand dunes, and such
other areas already certified as public forest lands, in accordance with the provisions of Commonwealth Act
(d) Appropriation to continue the classification, survey and subdivision of agricultural lands of the public
domain especially those lying along the National highways, the sum of P170, 000 to be spent by the Bureau of
Forestry in accordance with Commonwealth Act. No. 627 and the sum of P1, 180, 000 to be spent by the
Bureau of Lands in accordance with the said Commonwealth Act No. 630 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 1,350,000.00
(e) For the organization, maintenance and operation of a School of Fisheries under the Division of Fisheries . .
. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 333,000.00
(f) For the creation of a special fund to be known as the "Cinchona Plantation Revolving Fund" for the
establishment, cultivation, development, maintenance, and operation of cinchona plantations in public forest
lands to be administered by the Bureau of Forestry. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
150,000.00

So much of the funds herein appropriated as may not be covered by the excess in the sums
appropriated in the General Appropriation Law for the fiscal year ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and
forty-six from the Coconut Oil Excise Tax Fund shall not be released unless and until the Secretary of Finance
and the Auditor General shall have certified that there are existing and available amounts from the latter fund.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 1, 1945.
